query:
SELECT g.id,
                      COALESCE(g.name, g.id::text) AS "name!",
                      g.icon
                 FROM guilds_present gp
                 JOIN guilds g ON g.id = gp.guild_id
                WHERE g.owner_id = $1
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                FROM guild_members m
                               WHERE m.guild_id = g.id AND m.user_id = $1)
                ORDER BY lower(COALESCE(g.name, '')), g.id
